name: @clisbot/channels-whatsapp
description: In-repo WhatsApp channel vertical (WhatsApp Web linked device). Ported from extensions/whatsapp/src@3928bad9bad (OpenClaw v2026.9.2): the Baileys socket and reconnect owner, the QR login state machine, the inbound normalizer/extractor/media download, the send path with outbound mentions, the react action and target normalization. Upstream's SDK is Baileys, pinned at upstream's version; the linked-device auth state is held in the Hub's encrypted keyed store (fusion/auth-fs.ts).
